summary: Map caller-owned uniform draws in [0,1) to one birth position inside a Cartesian beam-grid cell via the source's zero-mean affine map.

identity.relation: position = cell_center_cm + cell_width_cm * (uniform_draws - 0.5), evaluated per axis.
identity.direction: cell center + cell widths + caller-owned uniform draws -> one birth position inside the cell
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM mc_beam_grid explicit-uniform Cartesian cell sample. The randomness stays caller-owned (deterministic, replayable mapping); draws must lie in [0, 1) and widths are nonnegative.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with a registered finite-output gate
identity.geometry: one Cartesian beam-grid cell; a 3-vector output
identity.coordinates: positions and widths in cm; draws dimensionless in [0, 1)
identity.boundary: finite shape-(3,) center/width/draws; nonnegative widths; draws in [0, 1); the output must remain finite
assumptions: The caller owns the random stream and supplies the uniform variates.
The Cartesian cell axes align with the coordinate axes of center and width.
No external physics reference is bound beyond the source closed form.

inputs.name: cell_center_cm
inputs.description: Cartesian center of the beam-grid cell.

inputs.name: cell_width_cm
inputs.description: Cartesian widths of the beam-grid cell.

inputs.name: uniform_draws
inputs.description: Caller-owned uniform variates, one per axis.

outputs.name: position_cm
outputs.description: One birth position inside the cell.
outputs.constraints: Finite (registered hardening: raises instead of returning Inf/NaN for finite extreme inputs).

preconditions: The caller owns the random stream and supplies the uniform variates.
supported: Per-particle Cartesian beam-grid cell birth-position sampling.
excluded: Cell-volume weighting, birth-velocity scaling, initial-state materialization, ionization paths, and any RNG ownership.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any vector is non-finite or misshaped, when a width is negative, or when any draw lies outside [0, 1).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the sampled position is non-finite for finite but extreme input magnitudes (registered hardening; the saved arm returns Inf silently).

example.description: Sample one birth position with fixed draws; the midpoint draw maps exactly to the cell center and a zero-width axis keeps the center coordinate.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import sample_beam_grid_cell
center = np.array([10.0, -20.0, 30.0])
width = np.array([2.0, 4.0, 6.0])
u = np.array([0.25, 0.75, 0.5])
result = sample_beam_grid_cell(cell_center_cm=center, cell_width_cm=width, uniform_draws=u)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result, center + width * (u - 0.5))
mid = sample_beam_grid_cell(cell_center_cm=center, cell_width_cm=width, uniform_draws=np.array([0.5, 0.5, 0.5]))
np.testing.assert_array_equal(mid, center)
try:
    sample_beam_grid_cell(cell_center_cm=center, cell_width_cm=width, uniform_draws=np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0.5]))
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('a draw at 1.0 must be rejected')
example.expected: The affine map holds per axis; the midpoint draw lands exactly on the center; a draw at the exclusive upper bound raises ValueError.
